summary: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Microsoft Entra authentication in public preview. You can sign in with your Microsoft Entra account to silently authenticate to a linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User (EMU) account, use your Microsoft 365 Copilot license, or both, depending on your organization’s entitlements.
takeaways: In this scenario, GitHub Copilot CLI uses GitHub inference, and usage is governed by the organization’s GitHub Copilot plan.

Model access and usage limits are managed through your organization’s Microsoft 365 Copilot settings, not GitHub.
